cohort: The study included 308 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital between July 2023 and July 2024.
finding: The incidence rate of neonatal hypoglycemia was 3.1 per 100 neonatal days of observation, with female sex, preterm birth, neonatal sepsis, cesarean delivery, and maternal gestational diabetes independently associated with a higher incidence.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be an independent predictor of neonatal hypoglycemia.
